critical_steps: Normalization and nonnegativity force vanishing on all nonzero differences of A.
Allowed translations outside A-A either fail coverage, yield an exact tiling, or give an integer incidence matrix whose augmented rational rank strictly exceeds its rank.
Fraction-free integer elimination exhausts all remaining cases; rational linear inconsistency implies real inconsistency.
An indicator of an actual tiling complement gives the converse.
integrity.exact_scope: All five abelian isomorphism classes of order 16, and every nonempty subset up to translation to include zero.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact enumeration of all 163840 origin-containing subsets of the five abelian groups of order 16, with deterministic integer-rank obstructions and direct tiling witnesses.
integrity.unproved_limits: No claim on minimal ambient order for non-tiling weak tiles, or on other finite abelian groups.

limitations: The theorem concerns finite abelian groups of order exactly 16, with no statement for order 32 or nonabelian groups.
It proves existence of an indicator tiling complement, not that every weak tiling weight is an indicator.
The exhaustive finite proof depends on the attached standalone exact-integer checker; no machine-independent formal proof is claimed.

title: Normalized weak tiling forces tiling in every abelian group of order \(16\)
